```{r}
#convert to grange

# Function to create GRanges objects for different entropy types
create_entropy_granges <- function(data, value_column) {
    GRanges(
        seqnames = data$chrom,
        ranges = IRanges(start = data$start, end = data$end),
        value = data[[value_column]]
    )
}

# Create GRanges for each passage and each type of entropy
# Passage -1
gr_p_1_observed <- create_entropy_granges(p_1, "observed_entropy")
```

#make function to generate all matrix (dmv)
```{r}
create_matrices_for_all <- function(p_1, p0, p5, gr_dmv_hyper, gr_dmv_unchanged) {
    # List of passages and their data
    passages <- list(
        "p_1" = p_1,
        "p0" = p0,
        "p5" = p5
    )
    
    # List of entropy categories to process
    entropy_categories <- c(
        "observed_entropy",
        "stochastic_mean",
        "stochastic_min", 
        "stochastic_max",
        "methylation",
        "allelic_entropy"
    )
    
    # Parameters for normalizeToMatrix (constant for all)
    matrix_params <- list(
        value_column = "value",
        mean_mode = "absolute",
        extend = 2000,
        w = 200,
        background = NA,
        smooth = TRUE,
        target_ratio = 0.7
    )
    
    # Output containers
    matrices_hyper <- list()
    matrices_unchanged <- list()
    
    # Loop through each passage
    for (passage_name in names(passages)) {
        print(paste("Processing", passage_name))
        
        passage_data <- passages[[passage_name]]
        matrices_hyper[[passage_name]] <- list()
        matrices_unchanged[[passage_name]] <- list()
        
        # Loop through each entropy category
        for (category in entropy_categories) {
            print(paste("  Processing", category))
            
            # Create GRanges for this category
            gr_current <- GRanges(
                seqnames = passage_data$chrom,
                ranges = IRanges(start = passage_data$start, end = passage_data$end),
                value = passage_data[[category]]
            )
            
            # Create matrices for both hyper and unchanged DMVs
            matrices_hyper[[passage_name]][[category]] <- normalizeToMatrix(
                gr_current, gr_dmv_hyper, 
                value_column = "value",
                mean_mode = matrix_params$mean_mode,
                extend = matrix_params$extend,
                w = matrix_params$w,
                background = matrix_params$background,
                smooth = matrix_params$smooth,
                target_ratio = matrix_params$target_ratio
            )
            
            matrices_unchanged[[passage_name]][[category]] <- normalizeToMatrix(
                gr_current, gr_dmv_unchanged,
                value_column = "value",
                mean_mode = matrix_params$mean_mode,
                extend = matrix_params$extend,
                w = matrix_params$w,
                background = matrix_params$background,
                smooth = matrix_params$smooth,
                target_ratio = matrix_params$target_ratio
            )
        }
    }
    
    return(list(
        hyper = matrices_hyper,
        unchanged = matrices_unchanged
    ))
}

# Usage:
all_matrices <- create_matrices_for_all(p_1, p0, p5, gr_dmv_hyper, gr_dmv_unchanged)

# Access examples:
# all_matrices$hyper$p_1$observed_entropy
# all_matrices$hyper$p0$stochastic_mean
# all_matrices$unchanged$p5$allelic_entropy
```

#test different ranges with methyaltion, make plot data
```{r}
create_all_plot_data <- function(matrices) {
    passages <- c("p_1", "p0", "p5")
    dmv_groups <- c("hyper", "unchanged")
    
    all_plot_data <- list(
        hyper = list(),
        unchanged = list()
    )
    
    for (group in dmv_groups) {
        for (passage in passages) {
            current_matrices <- matrices[[group]][[passage]]
            
            plot_data <- data.frame(
                position = 1:ncol(current_matrices$observed_entropy),
                # Observed entropy: 25-75th percentile range
                observed_mean = apply(current_matrices$observed_entropy, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)),
                observed_min = apply(current_matrices$observed_entropy, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
                observed_max = apply(current_matrices$observed_entropy, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
                # Stochastic: 25-75th percentile range
                stochastic_mean = apply(current_matrices$stochastic_min, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)),
                stochastic_min = apply(current_matrices$stochastic_min, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
                stochastic_max = apply(current_matrices$stochastic_max, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
              
                #methyaltion
                methy_mean = apply(current_matrices$methylation, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)),
                methy_min = apply(current_matrices$methylation, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
                methy_max = apply(current_matrices$methylation, 2, 
                                   function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
                
                # Allelic minimum for 25-75%
                allelic_mean = apply(current_matrices$allelic_entropy, 2,
                                     function(x) quantile(x, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)),
                allelic_min = apply(current_matrices$allelic_entropy, 2,
                                     function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
                allelic_max = apply(current_matrices$allelic_entropy, 2,
                                     function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
                
            )
            
            all_plot_data[[group]][[passage]] <- plot_data
        }
    }
    
    return(all_plot_data)
}

plot_data <- create_all_plot_data(all_matrices)

```

#use function to make plots (dmv)
```{r}
library("ggplot2")
# Function to create consistent plots
create_entropy_plot <- function(data, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = position)) +
    # Add vertical lines for region boundaries
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(10, 57), 
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    # Stochastic range and mean
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = stochastic_min, ymax = stochastic_max, fill = "Stochastic"), 
               alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = stochastic_mean, color = "Stochastic"), 
               method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
    
    # Allelic range and mean
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = allelic_min, ymax = allelic_max, fill = "Allelic-specific"), 
               alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = allelic_mean, color = "Allelic-specific"), 
               method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
    
    #methyaltion
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = methy_min, ymax =  methy_max, fill = "Methylation"), 
               alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = methy_mean, color = "Methylation"), 
               method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
    
    
    # Observed range and mean
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = observed_min, ymax = observed_max, fill = "Observed"), 
               alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = observed_mean, color = "Observed"), 
               method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
    
    # Colors and styling
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Stochastic" = "royalblue", 
                                 "Allelic-specific" = "red", 
                                 "Methylation" = "black",
                                 "Observed" = "seagreen"),
                      name = "Pattern type") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stochastic" = "royalblue", 
                                "Allelic-specific" = "red",
                                "Methylation" = "black",
                                "Observed" = "seagreen"),
                      name = "Pattern type") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 10, 57, 67),
      labels = c("-2kb", "0", "DMV end", "+2kb")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Position relative to CGI",
         y = "Methylation Entropy",
         title = title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

# Create individual plots
p0_plot_hyper <- create_entropy_plot(plot_data$hyper$p0, "Passage 0")
p_1_plot_hyper <- create_entropy_plot(plot_data$hyper$p_1, "Unpassaged")
p5_plot_hyper <- create_entropy_plot(plot_data$hyper$p5, "Passage 5")

p0_plot_unchanged <- create_entropy_plot(plot_data$unchanged$p0, "Passage 0")
p_1_plot_unchanged <- create_entropy_plot(plot_data$unchanged$p_1, "Unpassaged")
p5_plot_unchanged <- create_entropy_plot(plot_data$unchanged$p5, "Passage 5")


# Combine plots using patchwork
library(patchwork)
combined_plot_hyper <- p_1_plot_hyper / p0_plot_hyper / p5_plot_hyper +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") # Creates a single shared legend

combined_plot_unchanged <- p_1_plot_unchanged / p0_plot_unchanged / p5_plot_unchanged +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") # Creates a single shared legend


# Save the combined plot
ggsave("/vast/palmer/scratch/zsmith/mc3365/rlm_analysis/simulation/data/mef/methylation_entropy_hyper_dmv_cgi_meth.pdf", combined_plot_hyper, 
       width = 10, height = 12, units = "in")

ggsave("/vast/palmer/scratch/zsmith/mc3365/rlm_analysis/simulation/data/mef/methylation_entropy_unchanged_dmv_cgi_meth.pdf", combined_plot_unchanged, 
       width = 10, height = 12, units = "in")
```
